title: Каталог ролей и серверный impact editor
goal: Редактировать одну роль с точным до/после и массовым влиянием до записи.
implementation_notes: Каталог → страница одной роли; comparison is deferred until usage proves a need.
Server preview, а не только JS, вычисляет exact values and affected users.
Targets — structured multiselect, scopes — business labels.
Sticky action bar: reset, preview, change count, affected count, apply.
Revocation and scope reduction classified as impact, not automatically normal risk.
Capability descriptions are validated system metadata and are not edited in the normal product UI.
Rollback is a new previewed/audited change, not silent file restore.
acceptance_checks: Role editor rejects stale and invalid contract.
Impact counts unique affected users with multi-role behavior.
Privilege ceiling applies to definition changes.
E2E role scope change validates two affected user HTTP outcomes.
independent_review: Независимо оценить полноту impact analysis, mass revoke и multi-role cases.
